title: AI Coding Subscription API-Equivalent Value
methodology: API-equivalent value = a plan's full monthly usage limit priced at first-party API list rates. SemiAnalysis (Oct 5, 2026) metered every major subscription token type by token type (how far each usage meter moves per million input, cached-input, cache-write and output tokens), then priced the full allowance at API list prices. Because limits differ by model, Anthropic and OpenAI rows are now per plan × model. Where SemiAnalysis published both workloads, the primary value is the agentic mix (0.4% input, 96.6% cached input, 2.6% cache writes, 0.3% output) and the range runs from the chat mix (2% input, 75% cached input, 13% cache writes, 10% output) to agentic. Fable 5.1 can only use half of a Claude plan's limit, so its value leaves the other half for Opus/Sonnet. Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and SuperGrok rows were not part of the public SemiAnalysis figures and have not been re-checked since July 2026 (lower confidence). These are ceilings at full utilization; most users burn far less. Pay-per-token API rows (Meta Model API) are not subscriptions: they show the value of $100 of spend at the vendor's own standard list price, so a normal API is 1× and only discounted tiers rise above it. Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan values are computed from Xiaomi's published credit-per-token rates and API list prices (not measured by SemiAnalysis); range runs from V2.6-Flash at peak to V2.6-Pro used entirely off-peak. Benchmark tasks per month = API-equivalent value ÷ Artificial Analysis's measured cost per Intelligence Index task (v5, one effort level per model). It normalizes for token prices and verbosity across vendors, but it is a general benchmark, not coding in a specific agent, so treat it as an indicator.
